digest.component_or_area: binding store recovery and retirement completion
propositions: Incomplete retirement operations leaving exact identity in both live and retired state must be detected and safely completed at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary, after staleness validation but before first remote fetch
Completion requires exact agreement of local id and Jira key across tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry; any mismatch or corrupt state must safety-abort without unrelated mutation
Explicit unretire removes the durable tombstone and prevents completion; automatic responses (200, clear_absent, same-key confirm) do not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity
Production code must not mutate a binding entry obtained from all_bindings(); rich-text handler must use the narrow facade operation instead
